payload.reason: The evidence discusses methods for improving the quality of singing voice through various techniques, including pitch manipulation and evaluation metrics like Mean Opinion Score (MOS).

claims.text: The quality of singing voice can be measured using Mean Opinion Score (MOS), which evaluates the quality of converted singing voices.
The quality of singing voice is affected by pitch accuracy, which can be controlled during generation to improve the output quality.
Adversarially trained pitch regression networks can enhance the quality of singing voice by ensuring pitch-invariant representation.
